label: Bible Study
prompt: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a _____ woman.
verse: And now, my daughter, fear not; I will do to thee all that thou requirest: for all the city of my people doth know that thou art a virtuous woman.
note: Boaz's tribute to Ruth — the same phrase crowns the 'virtuous woman' poem in Proverbs 31.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all _____;
verse: Blessed be God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies, and the God of all comfort;
note: Paul calls Him the Father of mercies and the God of all comfort — no sorrow falls outside that 'all.'

label: Sunday School
prompt: All the king's servants, and the people of the king's provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or woman, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called, there is one law of his to put him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden _____, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.
verse: All the king's servants, and the people of the king's provinces, do know, that whosoever, whether man or woman, shall come unto the king into the inner court, who is not called, there is one law of his to put him to death, except such to whom the king shall hold out the golden sceptre, that he may live: but I have not been called to come in unto the king these thirty days.
note: Approaching the king uninvited meant death — unless he held out the golden sceptre. Esther had not been called in thirty days.

label: Deep Water
prompt: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and _____, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
verse: To the only wise God our Saviour, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and ever. Amen.
note: Jude ends his warnings with one of Scripture's grandest doxologies — the last word belongs to praise.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, _____ is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
verse: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
note: Paul quotes Deuteronomy 32:35 — 'Vengeance is mine' — as the reason to leave payback in God's hands.
